slug: 2024-01-01 Mauritius Civil Status Division Annual Report on Performance FY2023-2024

facts.fact: The Civil Status Division's report for financial year 2023/2024 states that its computerised CSD System, operational since November 2001, provides for the registration of births, deaths and marriages and stores all life-event data of Mauritian citizens in the CSD database.

The Division states that the CSD System registers births and deaths and generates each citizen's unique identification number at the time of registration of birth, the record being stored in the Division's single Civil Status Database; it does not describe the entry office by office.
The CSD System is the Civil Status Division's own, the Division being under the Prime Minister's Office and headed by the Registrar of Civil Status, with an IT Unit of system analysts on its staff.
The Division's Strategic Directions 2023/2024 name the revamping of the CSD System and digitalisation of CSD services, and its Way Forward lists completing the revamping of the CSD/CPD System.

The Division reports actual expenditure of Rs 387,863,137 against government budget estimates of Rs 445,600,000 for 2023/2024, covering IT equipment, its maintenance and the digitalisation of records, with no donor named; no line is given for the CSD System itself.

The Division reports for financial year 2023/2024 that the revamping of the Civil Status Database is under process, a new version of the linked Central Population Database having been operational since July/August 2023.
